procedure: Read next full specs without printing all prompt text to the chat. Inspect every listed reference with view_image. Source paths in production.json are relative to shinobij.client/public.

Call built-in image_gen separately for each identity, with that entry's exact prompt, all its reference-image paths, and transparent_background false. Independent calls may run together using Promise.allSettled. Store each successful tool result keyed by identity. Use generatedImage to show the outputs. Await or poll the same live functions.exec cell until terminal, never restart a still-live job merely because it has not returned yet.

Visually compare each result to its original illustration and current model-baked reference. Follow the current model for physical anatomy, limb count, accessories and tail shape. Starter illustrations are deliberately locked almost exactly to the original designs. Reject and revise a candidate that contradicts the current identity; do not mark it reviewed merely because image generation succeeded.

A successful tool result includes its saved PNG path in output_hint. Inspect EVERY output at full resolution against its original and model atlas: trace every limb, tail and wing to its attachment; check equipment grips/straps, facial details, unwanted marks, rendering, contact and framing. Prefer at least 6% scenic margin around extremities. A loading test or thumbnail check is never art approval.

Pass the selected PNG to accept only after visual review. It copies the master and encodes a 640px WebP, but now leaves status candidate and withholds its URL. Then call record-reviews with identity-specific visual observations. This records the exact master/delivery hashes and publishes the reviewed URL. Strict audit and unit tests reject missing or stale review attestations. Technical checks verify the review matches bytes; they do not judge art quality.

Do not re-run init. Do not regenerate identities already reviewed unless a concrete identity or quality problem warrants it. Rejected candidate images were never admitted to public delivery files; three earlier revisions overwrote their own selected-master/delivery filenames so obsolete variants are not retained in this workspace.

Visually inspect every banner, lantern, headplate and stone surface for single-spiral village motifs, including pointed leaf, flame-ring and carved-stone variants. Record specific observations with record-symbol-reviews. Revisions invalidate this review; both production audit and shipping gate require matching reviewed hashes. These technical checks bind manual inspection to bytes and do not recognize symbols automatically.
